# Health Databases

This folder contains national quality databases and registries dedicated to monitoring, evaluating, and improving healthcare treatment standards in Denmark. It currently houses the central infrastructure for tracking inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which aggregates patient data from the National Patient Register to benchmark clinical performance, monitor quality indicators, and ensure equitable, evidence-based care across all Danish regions.

## Pages

- [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] — The national registry (DANIBD) tracking over 33,000 adult and pediatric IBD patients, evaluating clinical quality indicators such as diagnostic workups, biological drug monitoring, and postoperative colonoscopies.
